channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Brown: The quiet crisis gurgling beneath our feet
item.description: Too many Minnesota towns can’t afford to maintain their crumbling water infrastructure.

item.title: Full brackets announced for 2026 boys hockey state tournament
item.description: Minnetonka received the No. 1 seed in 2A, Hibbing/Chisholm the top seed in 1A.

item.title: What it’s like to race a 5K ‘where no one has run before’ — the St. Paul skyway
item.description: Hundreds of racers navigated tight turns and stairs in a unique urban 5K, believed to be the first timed footrace in any skyway.

item.title: Quinn Hughes pops by ‘Saturday Night Live’
item.description: The gold-medal Olympics hero and Minnesota Wild star was joined by some fellow athletes.

item.title: As another rent payment nears, housing advocates warn of ‘huge emergency’ over evictions
item.description: Two recent reports estimate tens of millions of dollars in additional rent debt in Minnesota is attributable to Operation Metro Surge.

item.title: Minnesota rescuers rush to save the pets left behind by ICE surge
item.description: Across Minnesota, pets were left behind in empty houses and abandoned cars after immigration detentions — or surrendered by frightened owners.

item.title: Abbey Murphy sets program record for career goals as Gophers women’s hockey beats St. Cloud State 4-1
item.description: The Gophers forced a decisive Game 3 in the first-round WCHA playoff series against the Huskies.

item.title: Saturday’s snow moves south, tracks along Minnesota River Valley
item.description: The National Weather Service predicted the storm will drop about 2 to 4 inches of snow across southern Minnesota, with a few inches possible in the Twin Cities.

item.title: ICE surged in Minnesota to arrest criminals. Many of them were already in jail.
item.description: An analysis of the Trump administration’s “worst of the worst” list shows about half of the immigrants detained were not taken off the streets.

item.title: Iran's supreme leader killed in major attack by US and Israel
item.description: Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in a major attack by Israel and the United States, state media confirmed. Iran, which responded with its own counterassault, warned of more retribution.
